story.title: Ciputat Timur bakery/snack brand with cheese stick, tempeh cracker, cookies and custom cakes.
story.body: A Pertamina SMEXPO catalogue and a BRIN-linked UMKM project list both identify Batinos Pastry as a South Tangerang food business. Public materials list cheese stick, tempeh cracker, cookies/biskuit and cake formats, while the project handover supplies the Instagram handle @batinos.pastry.
